checkpoints.name: Credible delivered operation
checkpoints.expected: Supported setup/restart reaches usable authenticated business software with persistent essential records and a practical way to recover essential data. External dependencies/secrets are declared and safely sandboxed, failures are intelligible; a mock happy-path claim is insufficient.
checkpoints.full_credit: All expected elements are demonstrated by the required attempt and resulting state.
checkpoints.partial_credit: A material correct subset is observed; identify the missing element. No contradictory material outcome may receive partial credit.
checkpoints.zero_credit: Absent, contradicted or insufficient observed evidence; feature presence alone is insufficient.
acceptable_alternatives: Business-equivalent native records, supported handoffs or scoped approval paths preserving every cited constraint; no prescribed screen or schema.
